rationale: Erta brings product management expertise from medical-device and SaaS environments (Tendo, Veeva Systems) while Mahtabin is building AI-assisted bioinformatics solutions at Tetonic AI—a natural pairing where Erta's quantitative analysis and user-centered design skills could help shape Mahtabin's medical AI applications. Their complementary strengths in product strategy and computational biology could generate valuable cross-functional perspective on how to build and position medical AI tools effectively.
intro_message: Erta Muca, meet Mahtabin Rodela — Erta's product and project management background in medical devices (Tendo, Veeva) could complement Mahtabin's computational biology work on AI-assisted medical applications at Tetonic AI.
